segments.text: Let's turn your favorite skin into one of these—a figure you can hold.
Start with a new skin, or upload one you've already made. Then open the 3D printing page.
You can turn the model around and see how all the pieces fit together.
Download the files for free and make it yourself. Or buy a Figure Kit with 3D-printed parts and pre-cut stickers.
Now bring the files into your slicer, check the preview, and you're ready to print.
Once they're printed, let's put everything together.
And there you go, your skin, printed and put together. Try it yourself at entropydrop dot com.
